decisions.statement: A context replaced has no page read into that context.
A startup replaces the context.
A clearing replaces the context.
A compaction replaces the context.
A startup clears the record.
A clearing clears the record.
A compaction clears the record.
One agent's readings are cleared rather than another's.
A subagent's own session raises this event with the name of its seat.
The payload names the subagent acting.
The environment names only the seat.
The agent cleared is the agent acting rather than that agent's seat.
A seat's subagents keep their records when the seat's own context is replaced.
With no agent named only the stale readings go.
A reading last seen more than a day ago goes, whoever holds it.
The clearing and the sweeping are one reach across the record.
How many stale readings went is written down beside whether a record was taken.
A record that cannot be reached is left as the record is.
An index that will not answer which agents there are is a record that cannot be reached.
A record that was not there is no clearing.
Every source that replaces the context is written down whether or not a record went.
The note written down sits beside this hook's own page.
A record the sweep empties is left holding nothing rather than taken away.
Nothing proves this hook clears a record in the tree this hook sits in.
Proving that would write a record into that tree, which is another agent's.
The session begins either way.
This hook changes the record rather than judging a call.
This hook is the only hook that does.
A record an ended agent left behind is taken away.
A reading says the agent holds that body now rather than that it read it once.
A compaction leaves the agent holding a summary rather than the bodies it read.
A reading kept across a compaction would keep that page's body out of every later answer.

definition: a clearing of an agent's readings when its context is replaced rather than resumed
